description: Whether CGC can take a pre-booked pickup at a given date and time. Transfers run 24/7 by pre-booking, including Christmas Day. Standard rates apply 6am–8:30pm AEST; pickups between 8:30pm and 6am carry an after-hours fee, shown in the quote before booking. Holiday hours over Christmas and New Year 2026–27 (Queensland time): Christmas Eve until 6pm, Christmas Day 6am–7pm, Boxing Day 6am–7pm, New Year's Eve until 6pm, New Year's Day from 7am. A holiday surcharge applies on Christmas Day, Boxing Day and Easter Sunday, shown in the quote before booking. Same-day requests should phone 0416 131 285. The booking engine's closed days and closed windows (holiday hours included) answer available:false with the closure message; some windows close only some vehicles. Travel within 12 hours needs direct contact.
